contentText: Brazil's cinematic renaissance can be attributed to cultural investment, international collaboration, and a country coming to terms with its authoritarian past. Nadia Massih welcomes France 24's correspondent in Rio de Janeiro Jan Onoszko to offer us a world of perspective on Brazil's 7th Art.  The Secret Agent, winner of Two Golden Globes, touches on themes of dictatorship and paranoia, albeit in nuanced fashion, avoiding explicit historical references.
